dialogues.jp:
目覚ましの電池は切れるわ。変なヤギには遭う
わ、ななことぶつかってあいつは大切なものを
食われるわ……。
dialogues.en: "Man, this morning was horrible..."
dialogues.text: "Man, this morning was horrible..."

dialogues.jp: ──全部今朝のことじゃないか。
dialogues.en:
Encountering a crazy goat, being bumped into by Nanako and
getting her important things devoured...
dialogues.text:
Encountering a crazy goat, being bumped into by Nanako and
getting her important things devoured...

dialogues.jp:
せめて、あのヤギさえいなければ、こんなこと
にはならなかったんだ。
dialogues.en: This'd never have happened if that stupid goat didn't exist.
dialogues.text: This'd never have happened if that stupid goat didn't exist.

dialogues.jp:
俺はふと、杉並から借りて読んだ“ヌー”の特
集記事を思い出した。
dialogues.en:
I suddenly recalled a copy of "Nuu" that I borrowed form
Suginami awhile ago...
dialogues.text:
I suddenly recalled a copy of "Nuu" that I borrowed form
Suginami awhile ago...

dialogues.jp:
白魔術だか黒魔術だかの特集で、その中に悪魔
崇拝者はヤギをシンボルに使ったりするという
一説があったのだ。
dialogues.en:
It had a special feature on white and black magic, and the
symbol representing evilness, was a goat.
dialogues.text:
It had a special feature on white and black magic, and the
symbol representing evilness, was a goat.

dialogues.jp:
俺も、初めてあのヤギを見た時には、そんなこ
とを考えた気がする。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't help comparing the likeness of the two images
before my eyes...
dialogues.text:
I couldn't help comparing the likeness of the two images
before my eyes...

dialogues.jp: 俺の背中をヒヤリと冷たいものが伝う。
dialogues.en: A cold shiver ran down my spine.
dialogues.text: A cold shiver ran down my spine.

dialogues.jp: 「いかん。厄払いをしたほうがよさそうだ」
dialogues.en: "Grr... I should look into ways to exorcise it."
dialogues.text: "Grr... I should look into ways to exorcise it."

dialogues.jp:
俺はそそくさと島で唯一の神社へ足を運ぶこと
にした。
dialogues.en:
My feet headed to the direction of the only shrine on this
island.
dialogues.text:
My feet headed to the direction of the only shrine on this
island.

dialogues.jp: 神社の書入れ時は初詣と相場が決まっている。
dialogues.en:
The busiest period of shinto shrines is obviously the new
year.
dialogues.text:
The busiest period of shinto shrines is obviously the new
year.

dialogues.jp:
ましてや地元の小さな神社など日々の参拝客は
たかが知れている。
dialogues.en:
But even besides that, even a small shrine like this usually
gets quite a few worshippers.
dialogues.text:
But even besides that, even a small shrine like this usually
gets quite a few worshippers.

dialogues.jp:
珍しいことに、俺は石段を上った時点で数少な
い参拝客のひとりと出くわした。
dialogues.en: It was odd to see only one other person around, like now.
dialogues.text: It was odd to see only one other person around, like now.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ、ななこじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's Nanako."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's Nanako."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「あれあれ、朝倉くん……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, ah, Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ah, Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.jp:
お互いに、なぜ、こんな所で、と言いたげな表
情だった。
dialogues.en: Her face was questioning why I was here, just like my own.
dialogues.text: Her face was questioning why I was here, just like my own.

dialogues.jp: 「お参り？」
dialogues.en: "Praying?"
dialogues.text: "Praying?"

dialogues.jp: ななこが小さく頷く。
dialogues.en: Nanako nodded.
dialogues.text: Nanako nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「絵馬を掛けに」
dialogues.en: "With this votive picture..."
dialogues.text: "With this votive picture..."

dialogues.jp:
見ると、ななこは手にもった絵馬を大事そうに
胸に抱えている。
dialogues.en:
Taking a closer look, she was holding it close to her chest,
indeed.
dialogues.text:
Taking a closer look, she was holding it close to her chest,
indeed.

dialogues.jp: 何て書いてあるのかは見えなかった。
dialogues.en: I can't read what was written on it.
dialogues.text: I can't read what was written on it.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、人様の願い事を無理に盗み見する趣味は
ないけど。
dialogues.en:
Well, I'm not the kind to sneakily invade other people's
privacy, but...
dialogues.text:
Well, I'm not the kind to sneakily invade other people's
privacy, but...

dialogues.jp:
「絵馬……？　願いを書いて、収めるってヤツ？
　どんな願いをかけるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Votive picture...? You mean the kind you make a wish on?
What kind of wish did you make?"
dialogues.text:
"Votive picture...? You mean the kind you make a wish on?
What kind of wish did you make?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ちょいと身を乗り出す。
dialogues.en: My interest was perked now.
dialogues.text: My interest was perked now.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「うっひゃあ！　み、み、見ちゃあ、ダメです
　よぉ。人に見られたら、願いが叶わなくなる
　とかなんとか、かんとか……」
dialogues.en:
"Wahhh! D, don't look! I, if other people see the wish, it
won't, be, be granted..."
dialogues.text:
"Wahhh! D, don't look! I, if other people see the wish, it
won't, be, be granted..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「……絵馬にそんな言い伝えあったっけ」
dialogues.en: "...I don't remember hearing that about votive pictures."
dialogues.text: "...I don't remember hearing that about votive pictures."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「な、ないですけど、見て欲しくないんですっ
　てば……」
dialogues.en: "W, well, no, but I don't want you to looook..."
dialogues.text: "W, well, no, but I don't want you to looook..."

dialogues.jp:
ななこが絵馬をぎゅっと胸に抱え、俺に背を向
ける。
dialogues.en:
She held it even tighter to her body, turning her back to
me.
dialogues.text:
She held it even tighter to her body, turning her back to
me.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、いいよ。そんなに見られたくないって
　ものを無理して見たいとは思わん」
dialogues.en:
"Oh well, okay. If you don't want me to know so much, I
don't really want to know either."
dialogues.text:
"Oh well, okay. If you don't want me to know so much, I
don't really want to know either."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「ありがとうございます……。ところで、朝倉
　くんはここへ何を……？」
dialogues.en: "Thank you... what about you, what are you doing here...?"
dialogues.text: "Thank you... what about you, what are you doing here...?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「強いて言うと悪魔｛ばら／祓｝いかな」
dialogues.en: "Exorcising a powerful, evil spirit."
dialogues.text: "Exorcising a powerful, evil spirit."

dialogues.jp:
ななこが、眼鏡の奥で、パチパチと目を瞬かせ
る。
dialogues.en: Nanako's spectacles suddenly gleamed.
dialogues.text: Nanako's spectacles suddenly gleamed.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「神社ってそんなこともするんですか？」
dialogues.en: "You can do that in a shrine?"
dialogues.text: "You can do that in a shrine?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、来てみたんだが。偉い神さまが
　いるなら、何かしてくれるだろ」
dialogues.en:
"That's what I came here to find out. If God is indeed
almighty, I'm sure he could do it."
dialogues.text:
"That's what I came here to find out. If God is indeed
almighty, I'm sure he could do it."

dialogues.jp:
と言いつつ、ここがどんな神様を祀っているの
かもよくは知らない。
dialogues.en: Although, I don't know much about the God they worship here.
dialogues.text: Although, I don't know much about the God they worship here.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、あたしも見に行っていいですか？」
dialogues.en: "Can I come along as well?"
dialogues.text: "Can I come along as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「構わないよ」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
どことなく、嬉しそうな顔をしているななこを
連れて、拝殿に向かって、境内を歩き始めた。
dialogues.en:
Accompanied by Nanako, we passed through the front of the
shrine, and started walking within the grounds.
dialogues.text:
Accompanied by Nanako, we passed through the front of the
shrine, and started walking within the grounds.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「そう言えば、朝倉くんのクラスですよね？」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah, isn't she from your class?"
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah, isn't she from your class?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「んっ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「今度、転入してきた人、ここの巫女さんて聞
　いてますけど」
dialogues.en:
"That priestess transfer student I've been eharing so much
about."
dialogues.text:
"That priestess transfer student I've been eharing so much
about."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「環のことか？」
dialogues.en: "You mean Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "You mean Tamaki?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「どんな感じの人なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What kind of person do you think she is?"
dialogues.text: "What kind of person do you think she is?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「どんな感じの言われても……」
dialogues.en: "What do I think, eh..."
dialogues.text: "What do I think, eh..."

dialogues.jp: 清楚で可愛いことは確かだ。
dialogues.en: She was pretty and neat.
dialogues.text: She was pretty and neat.

dialogues.jp: たまにメチャクチャな行動をとるけど。
dialogues.en: She was a little outrageous at certain times, but.
dialogues.text: She was a little outrageous at certain times, but.

dialogues.jp:
最大の疑問は、なぜか、俺の｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝だと宣言した
ことだ。
dialogues.en:
The biggest question was, why she just announced to everyone
that I was her fiancee, like that.
dialogues.text:
The biggest question was, why she just announced to everyone
that I was her fiancee, like that.

dialogues.jp: 「なんつうか、その……」
dialogues.en: "Well, how do I say this..."
dialogues.text: "Well, how do I say this..."

dialogues.jp: 悩んだ末に、俺は言葉を濁すことにした。
dialogues.en:
I spoke vaguely, while racking my brain for a good
description.
dialogues.text:
I spoke vaguely, while racking my brain for a good
description.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、ひとことで言うと──」
dialogues.en: "To put it in a single word, she's--"
dialogues.text: "To put it in a single word, she's--"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様ではありませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 俺とななこが声のした方向に振り返る。
dialogues.en: Nanako and I turned towards the direction of the voice.
dialogues.text: Nanako and I turned towards the direction of the voice.

dialogues.jp: そこには環が立っていた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was standing there.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was standing there.

dialogues.jp: 目にもまぶしい白衣と、鮮やかな朱色の袴。
dialogues.en: She wore a elegant Miko robe, with a scarlet Hakama.
dialogues.text: She wore a elegant Miko robe, with a scarlet Hakama.

dialogues.jp:
どこから見ても、一分の隙もない完璧な巫女姿
だった。
dialogues.en:
No matter how you look at it, she resembled the complete
Miko.
dialogues.text:
No matter how you look at it, she resembled the complete
Miko.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ようこそ、お越しくださいました」
dialogues.en: "Welcome to our humble shrine."
dialogues.text: "Welcome to our humble shrine."

dialogues.jp:
環は礼儀正しく一礼すると、ちらっと視線をな
なこのほうに向けた。
dialogues.en: She bowed politely. Her eyes then strayed to my side.
dialogues.text: She bowed politely. Her eyes then strayed to my side.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様のご友人ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Might you be a friend of Asakura-sama's?"
dialogues.text: "Might you be a friend of Asakura-sama's?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「ふあぁぁぁ……、すごい……本物だぁ」
dialogues.en: "Woooooow.... amazing, it's the real thing!"
dialogues.text: "Woooooow.... amazing, it's the real thing!"

dialogues.jp:
ななこが目をきらきら輝かせながら、環の姿を
見ている。
dialogues.en: Nanako's eyes were glittering as they stared at Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Nanako's eyes were glittering as they stared at Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: が、環の声は聞こえてないようだ。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's words didn't penetrate her trance.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's words didn't penetrate her trance.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ah, um..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um..."

dialogues.jp:
環が｛けげん／怪訝｝そうな表情で、ななこにもう一度声を
かける。
dialogues.en:
With a slightly flustered face, she called out to Nanako
again.
dialogues.text:
With a slightly flustered face, she called out to Nanako
again.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「はっ、え……？　ああ！　また悪い癖が」
dialogues.en: "Haah, eh...? Ahh! I did it again..."
dialogues.text: "Haah, eh...? Ahh! I did it again..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「胡ノ宮環と申します。朝倉様のご友人でいらっ
　しゃいますか？」
dialogues.en:
"My name is Konomiya Tamaki. You would be a friend of
Asakura-sama's, right?"
dialogues.text:
"My name is Konomiya Tamaki. You would be a friend of
Asakura-sama's, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「あっ、はい。ご、ご友人って言っても、そのぉ
　今朝知り合ったばっかりで、友人って言って
　いいものかどうか、その」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, yes. A lot kinda happened this morning, but being
friends would be a good way to put it..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, yes. A lot kinda happened this morning, but being
friends would be a good way to put it..."

dialogues.jp: ななこがちらりと俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Nanako stole a glance at me.
dialogues.text: Nanako stole a glance at me.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「その、あたしと朝倉くんって、お友達……で
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "That is what we are... right?"
dialogues.text: "That is what we are... right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「お友達、だろ。今さら」
dialogues.en: "Now? Of course."
dialogues.text: "Now? Of course."

dialogues.jp:
ななこが苦笑気味に、メガネを外して、ハンカ
チで拭く。
dialogues.en:
With a smile, she removed her glasses, wiping them with her
handkerchief.
dialogues.text:
With a smile, she removed her glasses, wiping them with her
handkerchief.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「ということで、はい、そのご友人の彩珠なな
　こ、と言います」
dialogues.en:
"Then, I'm a friend of Asakura-kun's, Saitama Nanako. Nice
to meet you."
dialogues.text:
"Then, I'm a friend of Asakura-kun's, Saitama Nanako. Nice
to meet you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい、こちらこそよろしくお願い致します」
dialogues.en: "Nice to meet you too."
dialogues.text: "Nice to meet you too."

dialogues.jp: ふたりが挨拶を交わす。
dialogues.en: They exchanged pleasantries.
dialogues.text: They exchanged pleasantries.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日はおふたりともお参りですか？」
dialogues.en: "Did the two of you come to pray today?"
dialogues.text: "Did the two of you come to pray today?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、似たようなもんかな」
dialogues.en: "Well, you could say that."
dialogues.text: "Well, you could say that."

dialogues.jp:
悪魔的ヤギの厄落しに来たとは、さすがに言え
ない。
dialogues.en:
In the end, I couldn't really tell her that I was here to
exorcise a demon goat.
dialogues.text:
In the end, I couldn't really tell her that I was here to
exorcise a demon goat.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしは絵馬を掛けに」
dialogues.en: "I have a votive picture here..."
dialogues.text: "I have a votive picture here..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうでしたか。では、どうぞこちらに」
dialogues.en: "I see. Please follow me."
dialogues.text: "I see. Please follow me."

dialogues.jp: 環が先に立って歩き出す。
dialogues.en: Tamaki started walking off first.
dialogues.text: Tamaki started walking off first.

dialogues.jp: と思ったら、いきなり環が振り返った。
dialogues.en:
...Or so I thought, as she suddenly whirled around to face
us.
dialogues.text:
...Or so I thought, as she suddenly whirled around to face
us.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「参道を歩かれる時は端を歩いたほうが良いで
　すよ」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, it would be preferred if you walk at the sides
of the path."
dialogues.text:
"By the way, it would be preferred if you walk at the sides
of the path."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「えっ、そうなの？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, it would?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, it would?"

dialogues.jp: 環がニコッと微笑む。
dialogues.en: Tamaki smiled lightly as she explained.
dialogues.text: Tamaki smiled lightly as she explained.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「参道の真ん中は神々が通られますので、人は
　それを避け、端を歩くのが古くからの習わし
　なのです」
dialogues.en:
"In past times, the peasants would walk to the sides, so as
not to interfere with the Gods walking through the middle."
dialogues.text:
"In past times, the peasants would walk to the sides, so as
not to interfere with the Gods walking through the middle."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「し、知らなかった」
dialogues.en: "I didn't know that..."
dialogues.text: "I didn't know that..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしもです……」
dialogues.en: "Me neither..."
dialogues.text: "Me neither..."

dialogues.jp:
ななこは、そう言うと、ポケットから何かを取
り出し、ペンを走らせていた。
dialogues.en:
As she spoke, Nanako took out a pen and something else from
her pocket.
dialogues.text:
As she spoke, Nanako took out a pen and something else from
her pocket.

dialogues.jp:
そして『なるほど……』と呟きながら、ペンの
先をぺろりとなめた。
dialogues.en:
Muttering "I see..." to herself, she started scribbling
furiously.
dialogues.text:
Muttering "I see..." to herself, she started scribbling
furiously.

dialogues.jp: 「なにしてんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「うひゃぉう！　いえ！　ちょっと、タメにな
　る豆知識を聞いたんで、メモっておこうかな
　と思いまして」
dialogues.en:
"Gyahh! N, nothing! I was just thinking, hearing such a
ancient custom, that I had to make a memo of it..."
dialogues.text:
"Gyahh! N, nothing! I was just thinking, hearing such a
ancient custom, that I had to make a memo of it..."

dialogues.jp: 必要以上に驚くななこ。
dialogues.en: That was way more surprise than was needed, Nanako.
dialogues.text: That was way more surprise than was needed, Nanako.

dialogues.jp: 「メモ？」
dialogues.en: "A memo?"
dialogues.text: "A memo?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.en: "Y, yes..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yes..."

dialogues.jp:
ななこは、たははと苦笑しながら、メモ帳をポ
ケットに突っ込んだ。
dialogues.en:
Nanako shoved the memo pad back into her pocket, trying to
laugh it off.
dialogues.text:
Nanako shoved the memo pad back into her pocket, trying to
laugh it off.

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、制服姿の環ならともかく、巫女
姿で言われると、まるで厳かなご神託を受けて
いるような気分になる。
dialogues.en:
She was probably a little put off by Tamaki as well, looking
dignified in her element.
dialogues.text:
She was probably a little put off by Tamaki as well, looking
dignified in her element.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「では、参りましょうか」
dialogues.en: "In any case, let us go."
dialogues.text: "In any case, let us go."

dialogues.jp:
｛りん／凛｝とした雰囲気をまといながら、環が歩き出し、
俺とななこがそれに続く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki set off, with us following. A cool wind blew past us.
dialogues.text: Tamaki set off, with us following. A cool wind blew past us.

dialogues.jp: ほどなくして、拝殿に着いた。
dialogues.en: After a short walk, we reached the hall of worship.
dialogues.text: After a short walk, we reached the hall of worship.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「絵馬をご奉納されるのでしたら、あちらに」
dialogues.en: "The offering place for votive pictures is over there."
dialogues.text: "The offering place for votive pictures is over there."

dialogues.jp: 環が拝殿の隣りにある絵馬掛けを指差す。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki pointed to the side of the hall of worship, where
several votive pictures like Nanako's hung.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki pointed to the side of the hall of worship, where
several votive pictures like Nanako's hung.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: ななこが絵馬を持って、てけてけと駆けていく。
dialogues.en: Nanako dashed over to that area, like a little kid.
dialogues.text: Nanako dashed over to that area, like a little kid.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、俺は……と」
dialogues.en: "Well, now then..."
dialogues.text: "Well, now then..."

dialogues.jp:
悪魔払いだ、なんて言ってたけど、さすがに本
気でそんなことができるとは思っていない。
dialogues.en:
I wasn't really serious in thinking that I had to exorcise
that "demon goat" out of me.
dialogues.text:
I wasn't really serious in thinking that I had to exorcise
that "demon goat" out of me.

dialogues.jp:
ヤギが悪魔の使いとされていようと、しょせん
はただのほ乳類、家畜だ。
dialogues.en:
It's far more likely for that goat to be a simple domestic
animal rather than a tool of Satan.
dialogues.text:
It's far more likely for that goat to be a simple domestic
animal rather than a tool of Satan.

dialogues.jp: ……あの目は怖いけど。
dialogues.en: ...But those eyes are still scary.
dialogues.text: ...But those eyes are still scary.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、お参りでもするか」
dialogues.en: "I'd start praying."
dialogues.text: "I'd start praying."

dialogues.jp: 拝殿の階段を昇り、お賽銭箱の前に立つ。
dialogues.en:
I walked up the stairs of the hall of worship, stopping in
front of the offertory box.
dialogues.text:
I walked up the stairs of the hall of worship, stopping in
front of the offertory box.

dialogues.jp:
（環が見ているから、きちんとやんないとな。
　たしか、二礼二拍手一礼だったか）
dialogues.en: "(I better not fool around with Tamaki watching.)"
dialogues.text: "(I better not fool around with Tamaki watching.)"

dialogues.jp:
俺は賽銭箱に五円玉を投げ入れたあと、鈴を鳴
らし、頭を２回下げた。
dialogues.en:
Throwing a 5 yen coin inside, I waited for the sound of the
coin hitting the bottom of the box, and bowed.
dialogues.text:
Throwing a 5 yen coin inside, I waited for the sound of the
coin hitting the bottom of the box, and bowed.

dialogues.jp:
そして、２回拍手を打ったあと目を閉じ、心の
中で名前と住所を言い、願い事を伝える。
dialogues.en:
I clasped my hands together, and started to state my name
and wish, in my mind.
dialogues.text:
I clasped my hands together, and started to state my name
and wish, in my mind.

dialogues.jp:
（あまり多くは望みませんので、これ以上災難
　が来ませんように。……あ、それと音夢の健
　康もよろしくお願いします）
dialogues.en:
"(I don't have much to wish for, but please protect me from
misfortune... oh, and please keep Nemu in good health.)"
dialogues.text:
"(I don't have much to wish for, but please protect me from
misfortune... oh, and please keep Nemu in good health.)"

dialogues.jp: ま、こんなところでいいだろう。
dialogues.en: This should be good enough.
dialogues.text: This should be good enough.

dialogues.jp: 最後にもう１回、頭を下げると拝殿を降りた。
dialogues.en: For one last time, I bowed towards the hall of worship.
dialogues.text: For one last time, I bowed towards the hall of worship.

dialogues.jp: ななこも絵馬を掛けて、戻ってきていた。
dialogues.en: Nanako had returned from her own business too.
dialogues.text: Nanako had returned from her own business too.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしはまだ社務所のほうのお勤めが残っ
　てますので、これで失礼します」
dialogues.en:
"I still have matters to attend to at the shrine office, so
I shall take my leave."
dialogues.text:
"I still have matters to attend to at the shrine office, so
I shall take my leave."

dialogues.jp: 一礼して、環がしずしずと去っていく。
dialogues.en: With a bow, she slowly left.
dialogues.text: With a bow, she slowly left.

dialogues.jp:
その後ろ姿に見とれていたななこが、ため息と
ともに呟いた。
dialogues.en: As she disappeared from our view, Nanako sighed softly.
dialogues.text: As she disappeared from our view, Nanako sighed softly.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「胡ノ宮さんてスゴイですね。キレイだし、と
　ても落ち着いていて、同級生とは思えないで
　す」
dialogues.en:
"Konomiya-san's amazing... she's so pretty and composed,
it's hard to believe we're the same age."
dialogues.text:
"Konomiya-san's amazing... she's so pretty and composed,
it's hard to believe we're the same age."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「それに、本物の巫女さんって、衣装もスゴイっ
　て言うか」
dialogues.en: "Her Miko clothes are so authentic as well."
dialogues.text: "Her Miko clothes are so authentic as well."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、スゴイと言えばスゴイかな……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I suppose she is amazing..."
dialogues.text: "Well, I suppose she is amazing..."

dialogues.jp:
人前でもためらいなく矢を射るという大胆な行
動に出るかと思えば、一転して女性らしい、し
とやかな面もある。
dialogues.en:
Especially to be able to ignore crowds and shoot arrows
right in the middle...
dialogues.text:
Especially to be able to ignore crowds and shoot arrows
right in the middle...

dialogues.jp:
はっきり言ってしまえば、容姿端麗、文武両道
才色兼備とあと三つぐらいは四字熟語が付きそ
うなぐらい、際立った存在だ。
dialogues.en:
But really, she has the looks, smarts, intelligence, even
sportiness.
dialogues.text:
But really, she has the looks, smarts, intelligence, even
sportiness.

dialogues.jp:
なぜ、そんな彼女が俺を許嫁と呼ぶのか、それ
だけが今なお謎だが……。
dialogues.en:
Why would a girl as perfect as that, call herself my
fiancee? That's a real puzzle.
dialogues.text:
Why would a girl as perfect as that, call herself my
fiancee? That's a real puzzle.

dialogues.jp:
（杉並なら宇宙人の陰謀説と結びつけるんだろ
　うけど……）
dialogues.en:
"(Suginami would immediately suspect alien conspiracies, for
sure...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Suginami would immediately suspect alien conspiracies, for
sure...)"

dialogues.jp:
ふと、ななこが俺のことを眺めていることに気
づいた。
dialogues.en: I then noticed that Nanako was staring at me.
dialogues.text: I then noticed that Nanako was staring at me.

dialogues.jp: 「んっ、どうかした？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Something wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いえ、なんでもないです」
dialogues.en: "Ah, no, nothing."
dialogues.text: "Ah, no, nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「さて、俺たちも帰ろっか」
dialogues.en: "In that case, let's head back."
dialogues.text: "In that case, let's head back."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
夕暮れが差し迫るなか、俺たちは神社をあとに
した。
dialogues.en: With dusk quickly approaching, we left the shrine.
dialogues.text: With dusk quickly approaching, we left the shrine.

dialogues.jp: ◆厄払い◆
dialogues.en: ◆Exorcism?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Exorcism?◆

dialogues.jp:
放課後、今日ははげしくツイてない日だった。
今朝の悪魔の遣いヤギのせいだと思った俺は厄
払いをしに行くことにした。
dialogues.en:
After school, I thought of the many misfortunes that befell
me today. I wanted to exorcise the demon goat that attacked
me.
dialogues.text:
After school, I thought of the many misfortunes that befell
me today. I wanted to exorcise the demon goat that attacked
me.

dialogues.jp:
初音島唯一の、神社に赴くと絵馬を持ったなな
こがいた。
dialogues.en:
Heading to the only shrine on Hatsu-nejima, I found Nanako,
with a votive picture.
dialogues.text:
Heading to the only shrine on Hatsu-nejima, I found Nanako,
with a votive picture.

dialogues.jp:
ななこと話していると、環があらわれ、神社の
作法などを色々と教えてくれた。
dialogues.en:
While talking to Nanako, Tamaki found and brought us in,
teaching us about some of the etiquette used within the
shrine.
dialogues.text:
While talking to Nanako, Tamaki found and brought us in,
teaching us about some of the etiquette used within the
shrine.

dialogues.jp:
巫女姿の環に感嘆するななこ、しかしどうして
環は俺のこと｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝なんて言うのだろう……。
dialogues.en:
Nanako was enamoured with the miko costume-clad Tamaki, the
person who called herself my fiancee...
dialogues.text:
Nanako was enamoured with the miko costume-clad Tamaki, the
person who called herself my fiancee...

dialogues.jp: 夕暮れとともに俺達は神社を後にした。
dialogues.en: We left the shrine at the coming of dusk.
dialogues.text: We left the shrine at the coming of dusk.
